interface.shortDescription: Find pharmacogenomics guidelines, translate diplotypes, and retrieve prescribing recommendations via MCP. STDIO or Streamable HTTP.
interface.longDescription: Explore pharmacogenomics prescribing guidance from the keyless CPIC database API. Search gene-drug pairs, inspect guideline coverage and star alleles, translate diplotypes into phenotypes, and retrieve prescribing recommendations with their evidence and guideline context.
